altText: One hundred invented eligible cells are represented by 100 circles grouped by staining intensity: 50 unstained, 10 weak, 20 moderate and 20 strong. The same 100-cell denominator gives 50% positive cells, whereas intensity weights one, two and three give H-score 10 plus 40 plus 60 equals 110. Category rows are an explanatory grouping, not tissue geography. Allred is a separate categorical system. Neither quantity is a molecule count, a universal clinical cutoff or an interchangeable assay output.
